# VL53L1 Vendor Notes

This directory documents third-party material used for the `vl53l1` component.

Reference implementation and documentation:
- VL53L1-ULD-ESP (MIT): https://github.com/david-asher/VL53L1-ULD-ESP

If code from the above library is incorporated, ensure all license and attribution
requirements are preserved. For now, the component contains original code inspired by
the public API/flows and does not embed vendor sources directly.
